name: adapt_exposed_port_dockerfile_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: app_port.txt (a spec file the Dockerfile's EXPOSE port must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it and update the exposed port, not leave the stale value in place
prompts: Write a Dockerfile at the repo root FROM python:3.11-slim that sets WORKDIR /app, copies the current directory in, and EXPOSEs EXACTLY the port listed in app_port.txt (currently: 8000).
app_port.txt has changed. Update the Dockerfile's EXPOSE instruction to match the CURRENT contents of app_port.txt exactly.

disruptions.description: app_port.txt rewritten to a new required port

test_setup_files.check_port.py:
import re

with open('app_port.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    current = f.read().strip()
assert current, 'app_port.txt is empty'

with open('Dockerfile', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

m = re.search(r'(?im)^EXPOSE\s+(\d+)', content)
assert m, 'no EXPOSE line found in Dockerfile'
port = m.group(1)
assert port == current, f'Dockerfile EXPOSEs {port!r}, want the CURRENT app_port.txt value {current!r} (stale port not updated)'

print('PASS')
